description: Bounded exact edge-insertion profile minimizing the maximum triangle eccentricity for strictly convex integer point sets.

source.title: Optimal Triangulation
source.author: Tiow-Seng Tan
source.algorithm_paper: M. Bern, H. Edelsbrunner, D. Eppstein, S. Mitchell, and T. S. Tan, Edge Insertion for Optimal Triangulations, Discrete & Computational Geometry 10, 47-65 (1993), DOI 10.1007/BF02573962
source.copyright: The chapter and paper are copyrighted publications; this package independently implements a bounded algorithmic profile and includes no copied source code.

input.vertex_order: strict convex boundary order, clockwise or counterclockwise; no three vertices collinear

output.meaning: one-based rank of the minimum possible maximum squared eccentricity among distinct eccentricity-squared scores of all vertex triples; equal rational scores share a rank

algorithm_details.eccentricity: For a triangle, eccentricity is the distance from its circumcenter to the closed triangle. It is zero when the center is inside or on the triangle. If C is the largest squared side and A,B are the other squared sides, an obtuse triangle has e^2 = C*(C-A-B)^2/(16*area2^2), where area2 is the absolute doubled area. Comparisons use reduced exact rational values.
algorithm_details.primary: Start with the vertex-zero fan. For every positive-eccentricity worst triangle, use each largest-angle vertex (largest opposite squared side, ties by vertex order) as an anchor. Try absent chords from that anchor which cross the triangle's opposite edge. Insert the chord, remove every crossed diagonal, and enumerate only triangulations that preserve all uncrossed old edges and contain the inserted chord. Accept an insertion if its maximum e^2 is smaller, or if equal and its set of worst triangle triples is a proper subset of the previous set. Restart after the first improving insertion. The bounded retessellation enumerator considers at most Catalan(4)=14 triangulations.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: Recursively enumerate every convex-polygon triangulation, compute each triangle score by constructing the exact rational circumcenter and measuring its minimum distance to the three closed edge segments, then take the minimum maximum score.
algorithm_details.termination: Each accepted insertion strictly decreases the finite objective ordering (maximum e^2, then worst-triangle set under proper inclusion). There are at most 14 triangulations in this profile.
algorithm_details.arithmetic_bound: For coordinates in [-4,4], side-square values are at most 128 and doubled areas at most 128. The unreduced eccentricity numerator is at most 8,388,608, the denominator at most 262,144, and rational cross-products remain below 2.2e12; all fit signed 64-bit arithmetic.
